tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---INITIAL---"; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "---NEW---"; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "---COUNTS---"; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command: hops fg create customersbba17b --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string:unique record key,name:string,balance_eur:double:balance in EUR,updated_at:bigint:epoch ms event time" --description "Customers initial schema" --json 2>&1
hops fg insert customersbba17b --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -30

hops fg create customersbba17b --version 2 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --online --features "row_id:string:unique record key,full_name:string:replaces name,balance:double:balance currency varies,currency:string:ISO code,updated_at:bigint:epoch ms event time" --description "Customers new schema (reload)" --json 2>&1 | tail -50
hops fg insert customersbba17b --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg preview customersbba17b --version 2 --json 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|compatibility\|pip install\|Logged in\|Base URL" | head -40
